name: frontend_styling_and_ux
description: Enforces Shadcn UI, Tailwind CSS 4.3, mobile parity, and premium UX. Requires full-width pages for ERP Add/Edit forms (no modals/sheets) and prohibits native browser prompts or alerts.

name: frontend_architecture
description: Covers React 18.2, Inertia.js 2.0, TypeScript 5.0, Zustand state management, and real-time updates handling (WebSockets/SSE with graceful degradation).

name: backend_architecture
description: Strict Laravel 12 modular architecture using nwidart/laravel-modules. Enforces thin controllers and services, and strict isolation between domains (e.g., ERP vs. CRM).

name: i18n_localization
description: Mandates zero hardcoded strings. All UI text must be translatable via modular PHP arrays, explicitly forbidding global JSON translation files.

name: financial_and_currency_handling
description: Prohibits hardcoded currencies. Enforces dynamic formatting of monetary values based on the business's or client's active currency using global formatter utilities.

name: validation_and_security
description: Requires tri-path validation (Happy path, Edge cases, Security limits). Enforces strict subscription gating, data leak prevention, and prohibits exposing the Laravel footprint.

name: testing_and_comprehensive_edits
description: Enforces complete cross-stack sweeps for every change, ensuring frontend and backend remain synced. Requires unit, feature, and Playwright E2E tests for stability.
